column12: Follow Sensirion SCD4x handling instructions. One reflow cycle only; maximum sensor temperature 245°C, peak duration <30 s. No vapor-phase soldering, additional flux application, or post-reflow board washing. Do not remove, wet, or damage the protective membrane. Keep the specified thermal-relief-hole area free of solder and flux. Protect the sensor from flux and cleaning agents during subsequent THT assembly.
Male 1x4 2.54 mm header, mount on bottom side, mating pins facing downward
